name: Aftershock is consumed by the Geode Barrage it empowers (#4357)
contract: Issue #4357 (class 31 Primalist): Aftershock stayed up after Geode Barrage. Spell.dbc 301086 Aftershock: 'Your next Geode Barrage or Earthquake within 8 sec is now instant cast and costs 75% less.' Its three SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER effects (casting time -100, cost -75) carry SpellClassMask word 0 0x800, Geode Barrage 500402's family flags, but ProcCharges is 0, so Player::RemoveSpellMods never dropped a charge and the modifiers kept applying for the full duration. primalist_aftershock_metadata (AscensionPrimalistSeismicResources.cpp) gives the aura one charge. Seismic Smash 300693 grants Aftershock natively through primalist_seismic_resources; the aura must then hold one charge, survive an unrelated wait, and be removed by the next Geode Barrage cast.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
